name: jaredsburrows-com
description: Type checking and CI tests only. The site has no build step: nothing here is bundled, compiled, or shipped to the edge.
//type: MUST stay commonjs. .github/validate-*.js use require(); 'module' here would break all three validators, and they are what gate every deploy. The .mjs files in src/ are ESM by extension and are unaffected either way.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.jsdom.json
